With a raised brow, she taps to send a message, mildly intrigued by this person who clearly looked wealthy and refined.*

entries.name: Hell
entries.content:
Hell is inhabited by humans who have died and went to hell, and hellborn demons. Obviously, hell fucking sucks, being full of chaos and disorder.
Hell is divided into the seven rings, each representing the seven deadly sins: Lust, Pride, Greed, Gluttony, Sloth, Envy, and Wrath. Each ring has their own unique look and atmosphere corresponding to their sin.

entries.name: Pride Ring
entries.content: Pride is the topmost ring of hell, and is inhabited primarily by sinner demons. Its sky is red during the day, and a dark reddish-purple at night, with the moon being a glowing red pentagram.

entries.name: Wrath Ring
entries.content: Wrath is one of the nine rings that make up hell. Its sky is red during the day, and a dark reddish-purple at night, with the moon being a glowing red pentagram. The area of Wrath is largely rural, with a western style to its homes, beast, and its inhabitant's dress sense. There are many volcanoes in the Wrath ring.

entries.name: Gluttony Ring
entries.content: Gluttony is one of the nine rings that make up hell. Its sky its amber-colored, with a hexagonal pattern across it. True to its name, the inhabitants love to eat. The buildings are very bee-themed, its architecture based on hives.

entries.name: Greed Ring
entries.content: Greed is one of the nine rings that make up hell. The area is very industrial, with criminal and gang activity running rampant. Countless factories dot the area, pollution and garbage being incredibly common. The sky is green colored during the day, and a sherpa blue at night.

entries.name: Lust Ring
entries.content: Lust is one of the nine rings that make up hell. The area is a large, sprawling city with neon signs and 1940's style aesthetics. True to its name, sexual motifs are prevalent in the inhabitants, shops, and signs. The sky is a dark blue hue, the sky accentuated by spotlights.

entries.name: Envy Ring
entries.content: Envy is one of the nine rings that make up hell. The sky is a bright lime green during the day, and a dark turquoise during the night. Corporations dominate the place, massive, towering monoliths of skyscrapers serving as both the offices and living spaces. Corporate espionage is both common and militaristic.

entries.name: Sloth Ring
entries.content: Sloth is one of the nine rings that make up hell. The sky is light pinkish. The area is a large city, with medical buildings such as hospitals and clinics being very commonplace.

entries.name: Demons
entries.content:
Sinners are humans who've committed sins or crimes in their life, and who have died and went to hell. These humans are now demons, who's appearance varies widely from person to person. This is due to their demonic forms being based on their human self's aspects.
Sinners typically cannot live in any other ring of hell besides the Pride ring.

entries.name: Class & Status
entries.content:
The demons in hell have a very fixed social group.
The Ars Goetia rank very high in the hierarchy due to their royal status.
Imps and Hellhounds are considered the bottom of Hell's society, and are usually poor.
Sinners rank just above imps and hellhounds.

entries.name: Hellborn
entries.content: Hellborn demons are demons born in hell. They include imps, hellhounds, succubi, and the Demons of Ars Goetia.

entries.name: Imps
entries.content: Imps are a species of hellborn demon. They commonly have red skin, horns, an arrow-tipped tail, black slitted pupils, and yellow sclera that glow in the dark.

entries.name: Hellhounds
entries.content:
Hellhounds are a species of hellborn demon. They look similar to anthropomorphic wolves, with wolf-like heads, fur, digitigrade legs, and tails. They have red sclera.
The majority of hellhounds have a servitude role, and are primarily used for their labor and work. Hellhounds can also be pets for other demons or can act as bodyguards

entries.name: The Goetia family
entries.content: The Demons of Ars Goetia are a species of hellborn demon. They consist of incredibly tall anthropomorphic avians. The Goetias are royalty, their status reflected in their expensive dress and lifestyle. They have an immense amount of power in Hell.
